A lion is in his house. A small mouse runs over the lion's face. The lion is angry. He catches the mouse.

"Please let me go," says the mouse. "One day I can help you."

The lion laughs. "You are small. How can you help me?" But he lets the mouse go.

Later, some men catch the lion. They tie him with a strong rope. The lion roars. The mouse hears him. He runs to the lion.

"Do not worry," says the mouse. "I can help you."

The mouse bites the rope. He bites it again and again. At last, the rope is open. The lion is free.

"Thank you, little mouse," says the lion. "Now I know that a small friend can help a big lion."

The mouse's family is happy. The lion walks to the water with his friend.
